recommendations.report_quote: document the limit, or open reads via validated handles.
recommendations.reason: Documenting is an honest exposure limit, not remediation; validated handles must be acquired under stable directory authority. Merely open after validate still races. Source move path also needs independent source anchoring.
recommendations.preserves_controls: Retain allow-list/Unicode/quote/case checks, media and text compatibility, correct Windows limitation; descriptor identity must precede use.
recommendations.required_validation: Test file/parent swaps on read/media/edit/move-source, allowed positives, OS permissions and Linux/macOS/Windows; confirm no external reads/moves.

recommendations.report_quote: loop-swap a subdirectory with a symlink to an outside directory while calling `read_text_file` and `move_file` on a path beneath it.
recommendations.reason: Controlled race test can characterize known path-reopen risk; nondetection alone cannot establish absence. Existing code likely fails desired blocked control under successful race.
recommendations.preserves_controls: Disposable owned files, source/destination checks and allowed operations; avoid interpreting one platform as universal.
recommendations.required_validation: Instrument/deterministically synchronize check/use windows where possible, assert outside contents untouched, cover move source and existing destination races.

recommendations.report_quote: with the host's approval settings, ask the model to write `.claude/settings.json` or a git hook.
recommendations.reason: Host-specific controlled approval/persistence test is suitable; legitimate approved writes may be intended. No server mandate to reject all such files.
recommendations.preserves_controls: Preserve explicit authorized business writes and bind approval to target/content; use fake inert hook only.
recommendations.required_validation: Obtain actual client approval policy and test approved/unapproved writes plus future execution without active malicious content.

recommendations.report_quote: call `read_text_file` on a very large file, `head: 0`, a FIFO, and a deep tree.
recommendations.reason: Resource scenarios useful, but read_text_file on a directory does not exercise traversal depth. Deep tree must use search_files/directory_tree. Controlled desired bounded result is not current guarantee.
recommendations.preserves_controls: Preserve ordinary reads/traversals and isolate blocking FIFO tests with supervisor/time/resource limits.
recommendations.required_validation: Use actual traversal tools for tree case; test huge single line, batch count, media encoding and explicit output budgets. Verify process cleanup after blocking reads.

recommendations.report_quote: send roots `/`, then an empty roots update.
recommendations.reason: Valid legacy-client test of documented host-controlled scope replacement and subsequent access revocation, not a proposed CLI-ceiling redesign.

recommendations.required_validation: Use legacy client declaring Roots, verify allowed access before/after valid/empty updates, stale answers and pending-operation behavior; modern connection must stay CLI-bound.

recommendations.report_quote: rebuild the image twice and diff the resolved dependency trees.
recommendations.reason: Useful drift check but equal results at one time do not prove reproducible lock pinning; initial isolated npm install re-resolves declared ranges.
recommendations.preserves_controls: Retain supported Node >=24, package build artifacts and root override intentions when restructuring build; scripts disabled production install.
recommendations.required_validation: Inspect exact build inputs/base digest/lock and root overrides; then controlled isolated rebuilds with fixed inputs and record tree/artifact hashes.

recommendations.report_quote: check that the container's user and mounts are non-root and `ro` where intended.
recommendations.reason: Correct deployer-owned isolation validation; readonly only where intended since server explicitly supports writes. No supplied deployment evidence.

recommendations.required_validation: Inspect actual image uid, runtime override/mount permissions, outside paths/sockets/capabilities and test permitted reads/writes plus denials.
